record.part_note: ST VL53L8CX 8x8 multizone ToF — the OTHER generation Pollen's tofd supports (research/raw/tof_src_main.rs:83-85). Everything here was read off datasheet.pdf IN THIS FOLDER, fetched 2026-09-02 from st.com.
record.description: p.1 verbatim: 'Low-power high-performance 8x8 multizone Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensor'. 'Ranging up to 400 cm, with enhanced performance under ambient light'; 'Requires 1.8 V core supply and 3.3 V AVDD supply'; 'Optional 1.2 V or 1.8 V IOVDD interface voltage levels'; 'I²C (up to 1 MHz) or SPI (up to 3 MHz) interface'.
record.datasheet_rev: Footer verbatim: 'DS14161 - Rev 12 - July 2025' (p.1) and 'DS14161 - Rev 12' on every page; 45 pages. HTTP 200, 3587088 bytes, fetched 2026-09-02.
record.identity_vs_fitted: Which generation ships is CANNOT DETERMINE (see part:vl53l5cx). This record is for the L8CX.
record.package: Table 1 p.4: 'Package | Optical LGA16'; 'Size | 6.4 x 3.0 x 1.75 mm' (0.25 mm taller than the L5CX's 1.5).
record.absolute_max: Table 11. Absolute maximum ratings, p.20, verbatim: 'AVDD | -0.5 | — | 3.47'; 'CORE_1V8 | -0.5 | — | 1.98'; 'IOVDD | -0.5 | — | 1.98' V.

supplies.name: AVDD
supplies.cite: Table 12. Recommended operating conditions, p.20: 'AVDD supply | 3.13 | 3.3 | 3.47'. Note: 'All three supplies are independent.'

supplies.name: IOVDD
supplies.cite: Table 12 p.20: 'IOVDD supply with 1.2 V configuration | 1.08 | 1.2 | 1.32'; 'IOVDD supply with 1.8 V configuration | 1.62 | 1.8 | 1.98'. THERE IS NO 3.3 V IOVDD CONFIGURATION — abs max IOVDD is 1.98 V (Table 11). p.7 Note: 'All digital signals must be driven to the IOVDD level.'

current_mA.typical_basis: DERIVED SUM: 43 mA AVDD + 50 mA CORE_1V8 + 0.003 mA IOVDD. Table 14. Current consumption, p.21, verbatim: 'Active ranging | 43 | 50 | 50 | 80 | 0.003 | 0.006 | mA' (AVDD typ/max, CORE_1V8 typ/max, IOVDD typ/max). Table 15 p.21: 'Continuous mode (4x4 or 8x8 mode) | 215 | mW' at AVDD 3.3 V, IOVDD/CORE_1V8 1.8 V — 43×3.3 + 50×1.8 = 231.9 mW, within 8% of the printed 215 (typicals, not a contradiction claimed).
current_mA.peak_basis: DERIVED WORST CASE: (50+10) + (80+10) + (0.006+10). p.21 verbatim: 'CORE_1V8 peak current is the average value +10 mA.' 'AVDD peak current is the average current +10 mA.' 'IOVDD peak current is the average value +10 mA.'
current_mA.cite: Table 14 p.21; preamble: 'Typical values quoted are for nominal voltage, process, and temperature (23°C).' 'Maximum values are quoted for the worst case conditions (process, voltage, and temperature), unless stated otherwise (85°C)'.

logic.cite: IOVDD abs max 1.98 V (Table 11 p.20) and no 3.3 V IOVDD configuration (Table 12 p.20) — a 3.3 V I²C bus would exceed the absolute maximum on SDA/SCL unless the carrier board level-shifts. NOT 3.3 V tolerant, by the sheet's own numbers.

record.i2c_address: Table 1 p.4: 'I²C: 1 MHz serial bus, address: 0x52'; §5.x p.12 verbatim: 'VL53L8CX has a maximum speed of 1 Mbit/s/s and uses a device 8-bit address of 0x52.' 7-bit 0x29 is arithmetic.
record.fov: Table 2. FoV angles, p.4: 'Detection volume | 45° | 45° | 65°'; 'Collector exclusion zone | 57.6° | 57.6° | 85.9°'.
record.ranging: Table 1 p.4: 'Ranging | 2 to 400 cm per zone'; 'Sample rate | Up to 60 Hz'.
record.laser: § Laser safety, p.34, verbatim: 'Class 1 laser safety limits under all reasonably foreseeable conditions including single faults. This is in compliance with IEC 60825-1:2014.'
unknowns: DESIGN CONSEQUENCE, STATED NOT HIDDEN: if the L8CX is what ships, then the HAT's I2C3 (a 3.3 V RK3566 bus with 10 kΩ pull-ups R12/R13, docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §11) cannot be wired straight to the sensor — IOVDD max is 1.98 V. Either the breakout carries a level shifter and regulators (ST's SATEL-VL53L8 and the Adafruit/SparkFun boards do — NOT verified here, no board page fetched) or the pull-ups go to 1.8 V. CANNOT DETERMINE which.
DERIVED, NOT PRINTED: the three current scalars, the 7-bit address.
No inrush figure anywhere in DS14161.
